in_sanskrit.name: Kalansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Black lotus

The name is also associated with the black lotus flower, which is considered sacred in Hinduism. The black lotus is known for its resilience and ability to bloom even in adverse conditions, making it a symbol of strength and perseverance.
